jobs.occupation: AI Engineer – Manufacturing, Automation & Applied AI
jobs.description:
Hartmann Packaging A/S – Lyngby, Denmark

Would you like to apply Artificial Intelligence where it creates real-world impact in manufacturing?

Hartmann is looking for an AI Engineer to help accelerate the adoption of AI, machine learning, and automation across our global organization. This role will play a key part in transforming how we optimize manufacturing performance, operational processes, and data-driven decision-making through practical AI solutions.

You will join Hartmann’s Data, Analytics & AI team and become part of a growing digital transformation agenda where AI is expected to become a key enabler of operational excellence, process improvement, and future competitiveness.

It a experimentation role and a hands-on engineering position for someone who wants to develop, deploy, and scale AI solutions that create measurable business value in real operational environments.

The Role

As AI Engineer, you will become part of Hartmann’s Data, Analytics & AI team, reporting to the Head of Data, Analytics & AI, Jan Boldt.

You will work closely with stakeholders across Production, Digital Manufacturing, Global Process Excellence, Enterprise Systems, and Business Functions to identify opportunities where AI can simplify work, improve process quality, reduce manual effort, and create measurable business outcomes.

Your primary focus will be on manufacturing and operational excellence, helping Hartmann leverage AI, machine learning and automation to improve production performance, quality, process stability, waste reduction and operational decision-making across our factories.

While the role will also contribute to forecasting, planning and commercial analytics initiatives, the core mission is to unlock value from production and operational data and turn AI into a practical capability within Hartmann’s manufacturing environment.

Beyond developing solutions, you will play a key role in helping colleagues across the organization understand, adopt and utilize AI effectively. Success in this role will therefore not only be measured by the solutions you build, but also by your ability to increase AI awareness, capability and confidence throughout the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled solutions that improve manufacturing performance and operational excellence

• Build machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions based on production and operational data

• Identify opportunities for AI, automation, and machine learning during process design and continuous improvement initiatives

• Develop AI agents, intelligent workflows, and decision-support solutions

• Translate operational challenges and business needs into scalable AI use cases

• Support predictive analytics initiatives related to forecasting, planning, and optimization

• Collaborate closely with Data & Analytics, Global Process Excellence, Digital Manufacturing, and Enterprise Systems teams

• Drive AI adoption through training, workshops, and hands-on support for business users

• Ensure AI solutions are reliable, secure, explainable, and aligned with responsible AI principles

• Contribute to the development of Hartmann’s AI governance, standards, and best practices

We Imagine You Bring

• Experience developing AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics solutions from concept to implementation

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python

• Experience with modern AI technologies including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and automation platforms

• Understanding of machine learning, data engineering, APIs, and cloud-based AI services

• Experience translating business challenges into practical technology solutions

• Strong communication skills and the ability to engage non-technical stakeholders

• A hands-on approach and willingness to move from prototype to production deployment

It is considered an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Manufacturing or industrial environments

• Production data and operational analytics

• Process improvement and operational excellence initiatives

• Predictive maintenance and process optimization

• Databricks and modern cloud data platforms

• Industrial IoT and Digital Manufacturing environments

Personal Profile

You are curious, innovative, and motivated by turning emerging technologies into practical business value.

You enjoy working close to operations and business stakeholders and are energized by solving real-world problems rather than developing technology for its own sake.

You combine strong technical capabilities with a pragmatic mindset and can explain AI opportunities, limitations, and risks in a way that others understand and trust.

You are collaborative, proactive, and comfortable driving initiatives forward in a global organization with diverse stakeholders.

Hartmann Offers

You will join an international company with strong values, high complexity, and a clear strategic focus on digitalization, analytics, and AI as drivers of future growth.

The role offers significant influence on Hartmann’s AI agenda within a company characterized by:

• International manufacturing operations

• Significant investments in AI, analytics, and digitalization

• A strong operational excellence agenda

• High degree of ownership and responsibility

• A unique opportunity to help shape how AI is understood, adopted and applied across a global manufacturing organization with exposure to both manufacturing and commercial AI use cases

• Short decision-making paths and strong visibility across the organization

Location

The position is based at Hartmann’s headquarters in Lyngby, Denmark.

The company offers a flexible hybrid working environment, including one regular work-from-home day per week. The role includes approximately 20 annual travel days and collaboration with colleagues across Hartmann’s international operations.

Contact and Application

In this recruitment process we are assisted by European Search Company. For additional information about the position please contact Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 2080 1638 or Brian Ranvits on +45 2048 0548.

If you see yourself in the position, please send your application by using the apply button below. Note that candidates will be processed as they arrive, until the position is filled, so do not hesitate to submit your application.

About Hartmann Packaging

Founded in 1917, Hartmann is headquartered in Lyngby, Denmark. Hartmann is the world’s leading specialist in moulded fibre egg packaging and a trusted partner in the global food supply chain.

With more than 100 years of experience, we combine deep technology and manufacturing expertise with a strong global presence to design, produce, and deliver innovative moulded fibre products. In doing so, we provide sustainable packaging that helps feed the world – one carton at a time.

Hartmann employs approximately 2,800 employees across Europe, North America, South America, and APAC. Hartmann is part of the THORNICO Group.

Ready to build, not just support?

Are you a curious and driven student who loves structure, details and making things work better? Do you want real responsibility, broad HR exposure, and the chance to help build HR processes in a global industrial company with more than 125 years of history?

At DISA Industries, part of the Norican Group, we are looking for a Student Assistant in HR who is ready to take ownership, ask questions, and help us strengthen and develop our HR foundation.

This is not a “fetch‑and‑file” student job. This is a role where you’ll learn, contribute, and grow.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

• A small, dynamic HR setup – locally it will be you and the HR Business Partner, working closely together with real responsibility and short decision paths

• Hands‑on HR from day one – you’ll help build, structure and improve HR processes rather than just support existing ones

• Strong global backing – while the local team is small, we are part of a larger global HR team across the Norican Group

• A business in motion – DISA combines more than a century of industrial heritage with ongoing change, digitalisation and development

• A pragmatic, people‑focused environment where things get done through trust, collaboration and ownership

This role is ideal for you, if you thrive in a setting where you get responsibility, variety and ample of opportunities to learn. At DISA, many people stay for a long time – not because they have to, but because they want to.

Who You Are

You’re about to finish your bachelor’s degree or currently studying your master’s, for example cand.merc.psyk, cand.soc.hrm or a similar relevant programme, and you’re ready to put theory into practice.

You are:

• Proactive, driven and curious, with a strong sense of ownership

• Genuinely interested in HR processes, people data and organisational structures

• Structured, detail‑oriented and analytical. You like things to be correct and well‑organised

• Comfortable working independently and following tasks through from start to finish

• Motivated by learning and by being part of building something, not just maintaining it

Most importantly: you enjoy learning, improving things, are curious by heart and enjoy being part of a small dynamic team.

What We Offer

• A student job with substance, responsibility and learning

• Insight into HR in a global industrial organisation

• A chance to build skills that matter for your future career

• A welcoming, down‑to‑earth culture with high professionalism

This role is a strong match if you’re looking for a student job where you learn by doing, take responsibility, and build a solid foundation for a future HR career. You bring the curiosity and drive, and we will help develop your skillset.

What You’ll Do

Your tasks will evolve as you grow in the role, but will include a mix of operational HR work, such as:

• Supporting and developing core HR processes across the employee lifecycle

• Preparing and maintaining employment contracts, amendments and HR documentation for payroll

• Supporting the implementation and use of an HRIS, including data structure, quality and processes

• Ensuring HR data accuracy and well‑structured documentation

• Contributing to process design, standardisation and improvement

• Preparing analyses, overviews and HR material for local and global use

• Acting as a trusted HR support for employees and managers in daily matters

You’ll work closely with the HR Business Partner and gain insight into both local HR responsibility and global HR ways of working within Norican.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

Ready to learn more and ready to apply?

We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you want to build HR skills, take ownership, and be part of a company where people and values truly matter – we’d love to hear from you.

About Norican

NORICAN. Shaping Industry.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

DISA

DISA design, build and support premium green sand moulding and cashing machines for the ferrous and non-ferrous foundry industries. For 125 years they have delivered machines that last for decades, and they are highly respected by customers and peers for excellent levels of quality and service. DISA machines keep customers producing relentlessly to the very highest standards. And they empower foundry productivity with a lifetime of efficient and a lower cost per casting.

jobs.description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

At the heart of our technology is an embedded Linux–based camera system that records sports matches using multiple sensors. Using our advanced video processing algorithms, these streams are stitched together to present one continuous playfield.

Our AI and cloud teams then process the video using proprietary models that lead the industry in our field, enabling players and coaches to access detailed statistics such as goals, ball possession, passes, and more.

While dedicated teams own most of the video processing and AI development, you will interface closely with both worlds and have the opportunity to gain exposure across these domains.

Most work in this role focuses on Rust- and Python-based user-space Linux applications, Linux platform engineering, and firmware architecture, rather than low-level hardware or driver development. Our firmware stack primarily uses Rust, Python, and C, and fluency in at least two of these languages is preferred.

What You Will Do

• Develop and maintain Rust- and Python-based user-space applications running on Veo’s embedded Linux camera platform.

• Contribute to firmware architecture and Linux platform engineering for our camera system.

• Build and maintain integrations with cloud services, including REST APIs, OpenTelemetry, and AWS S3.

• Implement wireless communication features using BLE and Wi-Fi for connectivity with mobile devices.

• Develop and maintain application-layer protocols, including GATT services, Protobuf-based communication, and data serialization.

• Collaborate closely with AI, video processing, and cloud teams to support the broader camera platform.

• Improve system reliability and observability through diagnostics, state management, and monitoring.

What You Could Bring

• At least 5 years of experience and a background in electrical or software engineering.

• Strong foundation in modern software development practices, architecture, and design patterns.

• Experience building and evolving user-space applications in Rust or Python, with a focus on clean APIs, testability, and maintainability across an embedded device fleet.

• Experience developing software for embedded Linux systems (Yocto), including system services, D-Bus, device trees, state management, and diagnostics.

• Experience integrating embedded systems with cloud services such as REST APIs, OpenTelemetry, and AWS S3, including debugging and operational troubleshooting.

• Experience building applications that integrate BLE and Wi-Fi, including GATT services, connection management, Protobuf-based protocols, and communication with mobile devices.

• Familiarity with MCU development and RTOS environments are a nice to have. While most work happens in Linux user-space, exposure to low-level firmware or peripheral interfacing can be helpful when interacting with MCU firmware.

Environment

• Languages: Rust, Python, C

• Embedded Linux: Yocto / OpenEmbedded / meta-tegra

• RTOS: Zephyr

• Cloud & Observability: AWS S3, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loggly

• Infrastructure: NixOS

• Tooling: GitHub (Actions)

Tembi is building the intelligence layer for European e-commerce.

We monitor more than 1 million online retailers across Europe and transform billions of datapoints into market intelligence that helps logistics providers, retailers and technology companies understand where the market is moving before their competitors do.

The next generation of market intelligence will not be built on static reports and dashboards. It will be built on continuously evolving data pipelines, AI-assisted enrichment, and systems capable of turning fragmented web signals into trusted commercial insight at scale.

We are at a rare moment in the company’s journey:

the market opportunity is large, our product is gaining traction across Europe, and the engineering team is still small enough that great engineers leave fingerprints on everything they build.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong foundations in Python, infrastructure, data engineering and large-scale data systems to help us build the core of that platform.

The team you’ll join

You will join a tight-knit engineering team of software engineers and data engineers working closely together to evolve our Market Intelligence platform.

We are around 20 colleagues today, with customers across Europe and a multicultural office in central Copenhagen.

We work with flat hierarchies, short decision paths and high ownership. Engineers at Tembi work closely with Product, Customer Success and customers themselves to understand real problems and ship solutions that create value quickly.

This is not an environment where engineers disappear into narrow silos or spend months building in isolation. We value pragmatic execution, strong collaboration and people who enjoy solving difficult problems head-on.

Current technology environment

• 
Python

Distributed scraping infrastructure

• 
Large-scale data processing pipelines

CI/CD automation

TypeScript services and tooling

We continuously evolve our architecture as we expand into new markets, products and AI-driven capabilities.

What you’ll do

• 
Evolve and maintain our scraping engine while expanding into new European markets and adapting to an increasingly dynamic and competitive web landscape.

• 
Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and backend services powering Tembi’s market intelligence platform.

•

•

•

•

•

•

•

•

Why you’ll enjoy it here

• 
You will work on genuinely difficult engineering and data problems with direct business impact.

• 
Your work will influence product decisions, customer outcomes and the future direction of the platform.

•

We move fast, but we care deeply about building reliable systems and long-term value.

You’ll have direct visibility into how customers use what you build — often within weeks, not quarters.

We care more about curiosity, responsibility and impact than prestige or corporate titles.

•

Compensation and growth

We are a startup building for long-term impact, not a large corporation optimising for hierarchy and process.

This role is best suited for engineers motivated by ownership, meaningful technical challenges, customer impact and the opportunity to help shape a growing platform and engineering culture from the inside.

Compensation is tailored individually based on experience, responsibilities and team fit.

Application process

Selected candidates will continue through technical and team interviews, and we may include a practical technical assessment and personality assessment as part of the process.

We aim to move quickly while making thoughtful decisions for both the candidate and the team.

This is not a consultancy opportunity, and we respectfully ask not to be contacted regarding consultancy offers.

About the team

To support our growth and expanding portfolio of projects, we are strengthening our focus on the Project Management Office (PMO). You’ll get a key role in developing, maintain, train, and educate on the processes, methodology, and tool chain used in project execution.

Your Role

As PMO Lead, you will report to the Head of Projects & Delivery. You will become responsible for all aspects of our best-practice project execution and will be deeply involved in improving and developing our methodologies.

The PMO standardizes project practices, supports project managers and project teams, and represents a highly operational function.

• Delivering consistent, high-quality reporting and portfolio visibility

• Building trust and strong collaboration with project managers and key stakeholders
